audit_name: STAGE 6 GATE 0: CSIRO AHU9 Zero-Shot Transfer Reproduction & Audit
critical_audit_findings: AHU9ahuMaTemp and AHU9ahuSaTemp are 100% identical in raw data (diff=0 for all 457k rows); true pre-coil mixed air temperature is not physically logged.
SA_TEMPSPT was constant 12.89 degC (55.2 F) during LBNL model training, so LightGBM split importance for setpoint was 0; the model cannot extrapolate to CSIRO setpoints of 18-20 degC.
Stage 5 report stated 7 fault episodes, but official ground truth contains 54 fault episodes in this slice (RA damper, OA damper, zone drift, valves).
Stage 5 98.6% false alarm rate was computed across the entire slice; when isolated to strictly healthy points (3,956 points), breach rate is 98.66% with MAE=4.2956 degC and Bias=+4.2912 degC.
